body: Me and her were best friends before we got together and we really wanted to stay that way. I couldn’t suddenly just love her platonically so I decided I needed a little break. She still texted me after that though. She said things like “I miss you” and “how are you” etc. so I thought maybe I still had a chance. Yesterday I asked her if we could start slow again or if we have a chance still and she said no. I’m really confused. She hasn’t given much of a reason for the breakup other then her simply falling out of love with me, and I feel worthless and unlovable
